facts.text: The Savoy is on the Strand in London (WC2R 0EZ).
The hotel sits on the Waterloo Bridge bend of the Thames, with unobstructed views down both arms of the river, from the London Eye to Big Ben.
facts.excerpt: Its position right on the Waterloo Bridge bend gives it unobstructed views down both arms of the river, from the London Eye to Big Ben.

facts.text: Covent Garden, Soho, St James's, Green Park and the West End theatres are within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: It's walking distance to Covent Garden, Soho's buzzing bars and restaurants, St James’s and Green Park's wide-open spaces, and the West End theaters.

facts.text: The Savoy is London's first luxury hotel.
facts.excerpt: First opening over 135 years ago, this is London's first luxury hotel and still one of its most illustrious

facts.text: Monet painted his Views of the Thames series from one of the hotel's suites.
facts.excerpt: Monet painted his “Views of the Thames” series from one of its suites

facts.text: The hotel is home to the first electric lift, once known as the ascending room, which is still in use.
facts.excerpt: It's home to the first electric lift, previously known as “the ascending room,” and still in use

facts.text: Rooms and suites are in Art Deco or Edwardian style.
facts.excerpt: From decadent Art Deco designs to elegant Edwardian flourishes

facts.text: Many rooms and suites have river views.
facts.excerpt: Each of The Savoy's rooms and suites, many with unrivalled river views

facts.text: The Savoy Suite has a residential-style lounge with a fireplace and a private bar.
facts.excerpt: residential-style lounge with fireplace and private bar

facts.text: The One Bedroom River View Suite has an en-suite bathroom with a claw-foot bath and a separate sitting room.
facts.excerpt: large bedroom with en-suite bathroom and indulgent claw-foot bath, separate sitting room and entrance foyer

facts.text: The American Bar is London's oldest surviving cocktail bar.
facts.excerpt: London’s oldest surviving cocktail joint, the American Bar

facts.text: The hotel has three Gordon Ramsay restaurants.
facts.excerpt: You're spoiled with three Gordon Ramsay outposts
Gallery, which was refreshed in November 2024

facts.text: The hotel has a pool under an atrium roof, plus steam, sauna and a gym.
facts.excerpt: A twinkling pool basks under the light of its pretty atrium roof, there's steam, sauna, and a gym

facts.text: Children have their own check-in process, with homemade cookies and milk.
facts.excerpt: Little ones have their own check-in process, complete with homemade cookies and milk.

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Family room suits families of three or four, with one bedroom with a king-size bed and the other with two double beds.
facts.excerpt: Ideal for families of three or four. Elegant Edwardian design characterises the two bedrooms, one with king-size bed, the other with two double beds.

facts.text: The hotel is renovating all of its bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is currently renovating all bedrooms, with plans for completion by 2027.

facts.text: Room rates exclude a discretionary service charge of 5%.
facts.excerpt: Please note that room rates exclude a discretionary service charge at 5%.

facts.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee
